text:
### 2. Unauthorized Fraud (Bank Liable)  
**Scenario:** Criminal uses account without customer authorization  
**Characteristics:**
- Customer did not authorize transaction
- Criminal obtained access (stolen password, card, etc.)
- Customer's liability: £0 (if reported within 24 hours)  
**Examples:**
- Card stolen, used by criminal
- Password compromised, unauthorized online transfer
- Account takeover via phishing
- Card cloning at ATM  
**Bank Liability:**
- FirstUK Bank reimburses 100% of unauthorized loss
- Reimbursement within 10 business days
- No customer liability (unless gross negligence)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Fraud Liability Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy defining FirstUK Bank's liability and reimbursement obligations for unauthorized fraud scenarios where customers did not authorize transactions and criminals obtained access through compromised credentials or physical theft. The policy establishes zero customer liability if reported within 24 hours and mandates 100% bank reimbursement within 10 business days.
context: Criminal uses account without customer authorization
FirstUK Bank reimburses 100% of unauthorized loss

raw_entities.name: Zero Customer Liability for Unauthorized Fraud
raw_entities.description: Provision establishing that customers bear zero financial liability for unauthorized fraud transactions provided they report the incident to the bank within 24 hours of discovery.

raw_entities.name: Full Reimbursement of Unauthorized Loss
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring FirstUK Bank to reimburse customers 100% of losses resulting from unauthorized fraud transactions, establishing the bank's full liability for such incidents.
context: FirstUK Bank reimburses 100% of unauthorized loss

raw_entities.name: Reimbursement Processing Timeframe
raw_entities.description: Provision mandating that FirstUK Bank must process and complete reimbursement of unauthorized fraud losses within 10 business days of the claim being validated.

raw_entities.name: Gross Negligence Exception to Zero Liability
raw_entities.description: Provision establishing that customer zero-liability protection may be forfeited if the customer is found to have acted with gross negligence in safeguarding their credentials or account access.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access
raw_entities.description: Risk category covering scenarios where criminals gain unauthorized access to customer accounts through theft of credentials, physical cards, or social engineering attacks such as phishing, enabling fraudulent transactions without customer authorization.
context: Criminal uses account without customer authorization
Criminal obtained access (stolen password, card, etc.)

raw_entities.name: Card Cloning
raw_entities.description: Risk category covering fraudulent duplication of payment card data, typically at ATMs or point-of-sale terminals, enabling unauthorized transactions on cloned cards.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Card Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: Fraud scenario where a customer's payment card is stolen and subsequently used by a criminal to conduct unauthorized transactions, triggering bank liability and customer reimbursement obligations.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Online Transfer Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: Fraud scenario where a customer's online banking password is compromised, enabling criminals to conduct unauthorized electronic transfers from the customer's account.

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: Fraud scenario where criminals gain control of a customer account through phishing attacks or other social engineering methods, enabling unauthorized access and fraudulent transactions.

raw_entities.name: Card Cloning Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: Fraud scenario where a customer's card data is cloned at an ATM or similar terminal, enabling criminals to create duplicate cards and conduct unauthorized transactions.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Victim Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer who is the victim of unauthorized fraud, having not authorized transactions conducted on their account by criminals who obtained unauthorized access through stolen credentials or physical theft.
context: Criminal obtained access (stolen password, card, etc.)

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card subject to unauthorized fraud risk, including scenarios of theft and criminal use, as well as cloning at ATMs.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction
raw_entities.description: Financial transaction conducted on a customer account without the customer's authorization, initiated by a criminal who obtained unauthorized access to the account.
context: Criminal uses account without customer authorization
